onboarding.title: Make every arrival feel intentional.
onboarding.text: Tune the welcome, goodbye, verification, and role experience for new members and bots.
onboarding.introText: Configure the welcome and goodbye messages, rules, captcha, and separate role assignments for people and bots.
onboarding.welcomeDetail: Choose the channel and message new members see when they join.
onboarding.goodbyeDetail: Posted in the channel you pick when a member leaves. Leave the channel unset and Niko stays quiet.
onboarding.goodbyeColorHint: Six-digit hex color, for example ED4245
onboarding.joinRolesDetail: Keep human member roles and bot-specific roles independent.
onboarding.memberAutorolesHint: Assigned to people as they join.
onboarding.botAutorolesHint: Assigned only when another bot joins.
onboarding.verifyDetail: Set a rules channel and optional captcha gate.
onboarding.rulesPlaceholder: Write the rules members should acknowledge.
onboarding.verifyChannelHint: Save to post or refresh the public Verify panel in this channel.
onboarding.hintClick: Pressing Verify verifies immediately — no challenge.
onboarding.hintWeb: Pressing Verify opens a short captcha page on the website.
onboarding.hintDm: Pressing Verify sends a captcha image in DMs.
onboarding.enableCaptchaHint: Members press Verify in the public panel and complete the method you chose below
onboarding.kickOnFailHint: Remove users after their verification attempts are exhausted
onboarding.blockProxiesHint: Website method only: refuse open proxies, VPN exits, and Tor
onboarding.blockVpnHint: Website method only: refuse the ranges most VPNs and bypass scripts run from
